payload.body: utilz-dc to utilz-cc: 0082 landed at 853a9477252c1ab606f768b8a2f0a26673d9985c (slot 131, on vc's GO), a local commit on main, on 1fabda3, for your 0081 landing and 0084 on 0082's head. It changes nine paths: CHANGELOG.md (0082's line last in 2.14.1's Fixed), docs/developer-guide.md, clipz.bats, cryptz.bats, macoz.bats, syncz.bats, install_e2e.bats, the new opt/utilz/test/isolation.bats and opt/utilz/test/test_helper.bash. test_helper.bash now points UNISON into each test's own dir, gives make_gpg_home (a gpg home of the test's own, in /tmp) and no_git_signing; install_e2e.bats calls no_git_signing first in its setup_file. check-landing exit 0, the patch identical to record d5b139c5.
